sources.entry: PodcastMenu - PodcastMenu is a simple app which puts Overcast on your Mac's menu bar so you can listen to your favorite podcasts while you work.

summary.one_liner: PodcastMenu is a small Mac menu bar app that wraps Overcast so you can listen to podcasts while you work.
summary.what_it_does: The app places Overcast in the Mac's menu bar, so podcasts can be played without keeping the Overcast window open. While an episode is playing, the keyboard's media keys control playback: play/pause toggles the current episode, and forward/backward skip 30 seconds. The README links to a download for the latest release but does not describe a build or install process. It states compatibility only with OS X 10.11 or later. The author says the app is not official and is not affiliated with Overcast.
use_cases: listen to Overcast podcasts while working
control podcast playback with keyboard media keys
keep a podcast player in the Mac menu bar
skip back or forward 30 seconds in a podcast
how_to_run: Download the latest release from the link in the README (no build steps are given)
notable: Puts Overcast in the Mac menu bar
Media key support: play/pause and 30-second forward/backward
caveats: Only available for OS X 10.11 or later
License prohibits distribution on any App Store
Not an official Overcast app; author is not affiliated with Overcast
